gta-5.name: Prologue
gta-5.desc: In 2004, Michael Townley, Trevor Philips, and Brad Snider attempt to rob a bank in Ludendorff, North Yankton.
gta-5.reward: Access to Grand Theft Auto Online

gta-5.name: Franklin and Lamar
gta-5.desc: Franklin Clinton and his best friend Lamar Davis must repossess a pair of high-end sports cars and race them back to Simeon Yetarian's dealership.
gta-5.reward: Ability to play as Franklin Franklin's Safehouse Franklin's Buffalo S $250 Barber Shops Atomic Blimp Stunt Plane Time Trials Ammu-Nation Ammu-Nation Shooting Ranges Los Santos Customs Car Washes Beeker's Garage Movie Theatres Strip Club Cable Cars Fairground Rides Stunt Jumps Soapboxers Prostitutes Taxi Fares Stock Markets Convenience Stores Monkey Mosaics (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Repossession
gta-5.desc: Franklin and Lamar must repossess a green motorcycle belonging to a member of the Vagos gang.
gta-5.reward: Letter Scraps Monkey Mosaics are properly introduced by Lamar New weapons at Ammu-Nation Lamar is available for friend activities Simeon Yetarian as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Complications
gta-5.desc: Franklin must break into Michael's house and repossess his son's car without being detected by anyone on the property.
gta-5.reward: Ability to play as Michael Michael's mansion Franklin's Bagger Strip Club Cinemas Fairground Golf Tennis Michael De Santa as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Father/Son
gta-5.desc: Michael and Franklin try to save the former's son Jimmy from gangsters who have stolen Michael's yacht.
gta-5.reward: Los Santos Customs Garages Michael as a contact for Franklin and vice versa Jimmy as a contact for Franklin Jimmy and Franklin are able to hang out Jimmy De Santa as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Marriage Counseling
gta-5.desc: Michael and Franklin must chase a tennis coach who was caught sleeping with Michael's wife. Following the coach to a mansion in Vinewood Hills, Michael damages the house in his anger, unaware of the identity of its true owner.

gta-5.name: Daddy's Little Girl
gta-5.desc: Michael decides to take Jimmy for a bike ride on Vespucci Beach. When Jimmy reveals that his sister Tracey is "entertaining" some guests at a party on a yacht out in the ocean, Michael goes to crash the party and save his daughter.
gta-5.reward: Triathlons Tracey De Santa as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Chop
gta-5.desc: Lamar plans to earn some extra cash by getting into the kidnapping business, and convinces Franklin to help him kidnap a Ballas member named D with the help of his pet Rottweiler, Chop.
gta-5.reward: Chop

gta-5.name: The Long Stretch
gta-5.desc: Lamar and his friend Stretch ask Franklin to accompany them to a deal with D. When the deal turns out to be an ambush, the trio must escape from the Ballas and the police.
gta-5.reward: Stretch as a contact for Franklin Lamar and Stretch as Director Mode characters (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Friend Request
gta-5.desc: Michael reunites with his old friend Lester Crest, who asks him for a favor: to infiltrate the corporate headquarters of Lifeinvader and rig a prototype of their latest invention (the Lifeinvader Phone) with an explosive, which is later activated at a press conference, killing their founder and CEO, Jay Norris.
gta-5.reward: Clothing stores New customization options at Los Santos Customs Stock Market Rickie Lukens can be hired as a hacker (only if Michael gets a call from him post-mission)

gta-5.name: Casing the Jewel Store
gta-5.desc: Michael and Lester scout out and plan a robbery of a jewelry store to pay off the former's debt to Martin Madrazo.
gta-5.reward: Heist Crew Members as Director Mode characters (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Carbine Rifles
gta-5.desc: Steal some Carbine Rifles from the police.
gta-5.reward: Tactical team truck

gta-5.name: Bugstars Equipment
gta-5.desc: Steal an exterminator van.

gta-5.name: BZ Gas Grenades
gta-5.desc: Steal a van containing gas grenades.

gta-5.name: The Jewel Store Job
gta-5.desc: Michael, Franklin, and their accomplices steal millions of dollars' worth of jewelry from Vangelico, escaping from the police on motorbikes. The heist can be performed in two ways: Loud Approach or Smart Approach, based on the player's choice in Casing the Jewel Store.
gta-5.reward: Lester as a contact for Franklin Carbine Rifle and Tear Gas available at Ammu-Nation

gta-5.name: Mr. Philips
gta-5.desc: After discovering Michael is still alive, Trevor murders Johnny Klebitz and goes to kill more members of The Lost MC at their trailer park before they can retaliate. Afterwards, he intimidates Aztecas leader Ortega, securing control of Blaine County's methamphetamine trade.
gta-5.reward: Ability to play as Trevor Tattoo Parlors Antique Cavalry Dagger, Vintage Pistol and Sawed-Off Shotgun available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only (Antique Cavalry Dagger and Vintage Pistol)) Offroad Races Stock Car Racing (Enhanced version only) Trevor Philips and Wade Hebert as Director Mode characters (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Nervous Ron
gta-5.desc: Trevor is furious after some members of The Lost MC vandalized his trailer and heads to the Sandy Shores Airfield with his friend Ron Jakowski to kill them and take over their arms dealing business.
gta-5.reward: $62,680 Machete and Sniper Rifle available at Ammu-Nation (Enhanced version only) Properties New customization options at Los Santos Customs Aircraft hangar and helipad available at the Sandy Shores Airfield for Trevor Ron Jakowski as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Trevor Philips Industries
gta-5.desc: While meeting with Tao Cheng and his translator to negotiate a partnership with the Los Santos Triads, Trevor must defend his tlao lab from the Aztecas with the help of his crystal tlao manufacturer, Chef.
gta-5.reward: Tao Cheng as a contact for Trevor Grenade Launcher and Hatchet available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only (Hatchet))

gta-5.name: Crystal Maze
gta-5.desc: After discovering that the Triads have decided to use the O'Neil Brothers as suppliers instead of him, Trevor raids the O'Neils' farmhouse, which doubles as a tlao lab, and sets fire to the place, killing most of the brothers in the process.
gta-5.reward: Jerry Can available at Ammu-Nation Darts

gta-5.name: Friends Reunited
gta-5.desc: After his friend Wade Hebert returns with news of Michael's whereabouts, Trevor destroys The Lost MC's trailer park and travels to Los Santos with Wade, moving into the apartment of Wade's cousin Floyd.
gta-5.reward: Floyd's Apartment as a safehouse for Trevor Flight School Ability to play as Michael and Franklin again Sticky Bomb available at Ammu-Nation LSPD Auto Impound available to buy if Franklin has completed Pulling One Last Favor Floyd Hebert as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only) The Jewel Store Job payout

gta-5.name: Fame or Shame
gta-5.desc: After a tense reunion, Michael and Trevor hear that Tracey is trying out for Fame or Shame and go to the auditions to prevent her from humiliating herself. During the audition, Lazlow Jones performs a sexual pose on Tracey, and the duo pursue him in retaliation.
gta-5.reward: Michael as a contact for Trevor and vice versa Jimmy as a contact for Trevor Lazlow Jones and Fabien LaRouche as Director Mode characters (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Dead Man Walking
gta-5.desc: Michael meets with Dave Norton to discuss Trevor's return before Dave asks Michael for a favor: to infiltrate the city morgue and confirm the death of an FIB suspect.
gta-5.reward: Combat Pistol and Heavy Pistol available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only (Heavy Pistol)) Dave Norton as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Three's Company
gta-5.desc: After meeting Steve Haines, Michael is blackmailed into helping the FIB and must work with Franklin and Trevor to retrieve Mr. K from the IAA Headquarters.
gta-5.reward: Franklin as a contact for Trevor and vice versa Frogger available at Trevor's Airfield AP Pistol and Heavy Sniper available at Ammu-Nation Steve Haines as a Director Mode character (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: By the Book
gta-5.desc: Trevor must torture Mr. K to extract information that can help Michael and Dave identify and assassinate a suspected terrorist.
gta-5.reward: Devin Weston as a Director Mode character

gta-5.name: Scouting the Port
gta-5.desc: Trevor, Wade, and Floyd scout out the Port of Los Santos in preparation for a planned robbery of Merryweather Security.

gta-5.name: Minisub
gta-5.desc: Steal a submarine off a freighter.

gta-5.name: Cargobob
gta-5.desc: Steal the Cargobob from Fort Zancudo.

gta-5.name: The Merryweather Heist
gta-5.desc: Trevor, Michael, and Franklin steal a Merryweather high-tech device, either at the docks or out in the ocean, only to be forced to return it immediately afterwards. The heist can be performed in two ways: Freighter Method or Offshore Method, based on the player's choice in Scouting the Port.

gta-5.name: Did Somebody Say Yoga?
gta-5.desc: Michael decides to give yoga a try with his wife and her instructor to see what it's like. However, after Michael attacks the instructor in an outburst, and later unknowingly takes drugs while driving Jimmy back home from Burger Shot, he finds himself abandoned by his family.

gta-5.name: Hood Safari
gta-5.desc: Franklin, Trevor, and Lamar have to fight their way through an ambush at Grove Street after a drug deal set up by Stretch goes wrong.
gta-5.reward: Lamar as a contact for Trevor Sea Races Machine Pistol available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only)

gta-5.name: The Hotel Assassination
gta-5.desc: Lester asks Franklin to assassinate Brett Lowrey, the CEO of Bilkinton Research, to help his stock market manipulation, rewarding him with a new safehouse in Vinewood Hills.
gta-5.reward: $9,000 3671 Whispymound Drive as Franklin's new safehouse

gta-5.name: Blitz Play Intro
gta-5.desc: Michael, Franklin, and Trevor meet up with Steve Haines, Dave Norton, and Andreas Sanchez at the Murrieta Oil Field to discuss business.
gta-5.reward: Dave Norton as a contact for Franklin and Trevor

gta-5.name: Masks
gta-5.desc: Buy masks at a Vespucci Beach mask shop.

gta-5.name: Boiler Suits
gta-5.desc: Buy boiler suits at Ammu-Nation.

gta-5.name: Trash Truck
gta-5.desc: Steal a garbage truck.

gta-5.name: Tow Truck
gta-5.desc: Steal a tow truck.

gta-5.name: Blitz Play
gta-5.desc: Michael, Franklin, and Trevor must steal agency funds from an armored car and deliver them to Steve Haines' contact, Devin Weston.
gta-5.reward: Chef can be hired as a gunman New weapons at Ammu-Nation

gta-5.name: I Fought the Law...
gta-5.desc: Michael and Trevor pose as police officers to steal an Entity XF and a Cheetah for Devin Weston, after the cars' drivers are challenged to a street race by Franklin.
gta-5.reward: Final upgrades at Los Santos Customs (limo window tints, 100% brakes, armor and engine upgrades etc.) Nightstick available at Ammu-Nation Cheetah and Entity XF available for purchase on the Legendary Motorsport website

gta-5.name: Eye in the Sky
gta-5.desc: Trevor must use the LSPD's latest identification technology to locate the owner of a Z-Type so Franklin can steal the car for Devin Weston.

gta-5.name: Mr. Richards
gta-5.desc: Michael must persuade Rocco Pelosi to obey Solomon Richards' wishes for his latest film.
gta-5.reward: Solomon Richards as a contact for Michael Michael can access Backlot City Marksman Pistol and Musket available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only) Solomon Richards as a Director Mode character

gta-5.name: Caida Libre
gta-5.desc: Michael must shoot down Martin Madrazo's cousin's plane in order for Trevor to retrieve a package for Madrazo.
gta-5.reward: Patricia Madrazo as a Director Mode character

gta-5.name: Deep Inside
gta-5.desc: Franklin must infiltrate Backlot City to steal a JB 700 for Devin Weston.
gta-5.reward: JB 700 available for purchase on the Legendary Motorsport website

gta-5.name: Minor Turbulence
gta-5.desc: While hiding from Martin Madrazo with Michael, Trevor is informed of a Merryweather cargo plane carrying weapons and attempts to hijack it mid-flight.
gta-5.reward: Parachute, Homing Launcher and Rail Gun available at Ammu-Nation (Enhanced version only (Rail Gun)) Ability to play as Michael and Trevor again Free Parachutes when entering any aircraft

gta-5.name: Paleto Score Setup
gta-5.desc: Michael, Trevor, and Lester scout out the bank and police of Paleto Bay in preparation for a robbery.
gta-5.reward: Lester as a contact for Trevor Heist Crew Members as Director Mode characters

gta-5.name: Military Hardware
gta-5.desc: Steal the military convoy.
gta-5.reward: Combat PDW available at Ammu-Nation (Enhanced version only)

gta-5.name: Predator
gta-5.desc: Trevor, Michael, Franklin, and Chop hunt down the remaining O'Neil Brothers in the woods of Raton Canyon.

gta-5.name: The Paleto Score
gta-5.desc: Michael, Trevor, Franklin, and one accomplice rob the bank in Paleto Bay to finance an upcoming raid on a research facility.
gta-5.reward: $464,395 MG and Minigun available at Ammu-Nation

gta-5.name: Derailed
gta-5.desc: Michael and Trevor hijack a Merryweather train to nab whatever gold or loot it contains in the hopes of giving it to Martin Madrazo as a peace offering.

gta-5.name: Monkey Business
gta-5.desc: Michael, Dave Norton, and Steve Haines infiltrate a research facility to steal a neurotoxin, with help from Trevor and Franklin. Afterwards, Trevor returns Patricia to Martin Madrazo, along with his and Michael's peace offering, allowing the pair to return to Los Santos.
gta-5.reward: Trevor and Michael can freely re-enter Los Santos Michael has his Tailgater returned (with modifications) Pistol .50, Heavy Shotgun and Stun Gun available at Ammu-Nation (Enhanced version only (Heavy Shotgun))

gta-5.name: Hang Ten
gta-5.desc: After a confrontation with Floyd and Debra in their apartment, which results in their deaths, Trevor takes Wade to the Vanilla Unicorn strip club, which he decides to take over.
gta-5.reward: Vanilla Unicorn as a new safehouse for Trevor Michael, Franklin and Trevor now have bonuses at Vanilla Unicorn Mr. Raspberry Jam as a custom item for Trevor's Bodhi

gta-5.name: Surveying the Score
gta-5.desc: Michael, Franklin, Trevor, and Lester scout out the Union Depository Tower in preparation for their ultimate robbery.
gta-5.reward: First part of the Union Depository Intel

gta-5.name: Bury the Hatchet
gta-5.desc: Trevor loses his trust in Michael after discovering the truth about what went down in Ludendorff nine years prior, and abandons him to the mercy of the Los Santos Triads.

gta-5.name: Pack Man
gta-5.desc: After stealing the final car on Devin Weston's list, Franklin, Trevor, and Lamar attempt to deliver all the cars to Paleto Bay, despite the police's efforts to stop them.

gta-5.name: Fresh Meat
gta-5.desc: Franklin must find and rescue Michael from the Triads before they kill him.
gta-5.reward: Ability to play as Michael again

gta-5.name: Cleaning out the Bureau
gta-5.desc: Michael and Lester follow a janitor back to his house and steal his ID card in preparation for an upcoming job for Steve Haines: to break into the FIB Headquarters.

gta-5.name: Architect's Plans
gta-5.desc: Franklin must steal the briefcase of architect Chip Peterson containing the blueprints of the FIB Headquarters.

gta-5.name: Fire Truck
gta-5.desc: Steal a fire truck.

gta-5.name: Reuniting the Family
gta-5.desc: At Jimmy's advice, Michael decides to reunite the family at Dr. Friedlander's.
gta-5.reward: Michael can hang out with Amanda and Jimmy again The Tennis Court at Michael's home becomes available again

gta-5.name: The Bureau Raid
gta-5.desc: Michael, Franklin, and their accomplices infiltrate the FIB Headquarters to retrieve incriminating information against Steve Haines. Michael seizes the opportunity to delete his own criminal record, destroying Haines' leverage over him. The heist can be performed in two ways: Covert Approach or Roof Approach, based on the player's choice in Architect's Plans.

gta-5.name: The Wrap Up
gta-5.desc: After Michael and Dave Norton are betrayed by Steve Haines during a meeting at the Kortz Center, they become caught in a standoff between the FIB, IAA, and Merryweather. Trevor comes to Michael and Dave's rescue, having decided that he needs Michael alive for the Union Depository heist.

gta-5.name: Lamar Down
gta-5.desc: Franklin, Michael, and Trevor must work together to save Lamar from the Ballas after he was set up by Stretch. Afterwards, Dave Norton and Steve Haines approach Franklin with a new task.
gta-5.reward: Tanisha Jackson as a Director Mode character

gta-5.name: The Ballad of Rocco
gta-5.desc: Michael must chase and kill Rocco Pelosi and his accomplice after they attacked Solomon Richards. Afterwards, Solomon calls Michael back to the studio for a surprise.

gta-5.name: Legal Trouble
gta-5.desc: When Devin Weston attempts to have the film studio closed, threatening the end of production for the film he and Solomon have been making, Michael chases Weston's assistant to retrieve the film reel, with unforeseen consequences.

gta-5.name: Meltdown
gta-5.desc: Michael and Jimmy attend the premiere of Meltdown. However, Devin Weston arrives to tell Michael that he sent a Merryweather platoon to murder his family as revenge for interfering with his plans, forcing Michael to go and rescue them.

gta-5.name: Planning the Big Score
gta-5.desc: Michael, Trevor, Franklin, and Lester choose the approach and crew for their upcoming robbery of the Union Depository.

gta-5.name: Stingers
gta-5.desc: Steal a Police Transporter from the South Los Santos police station.

gta-5.name: Gauntlet
gta-5.desc: Steal and modify 3 Bravado Gauntlets.

gta-5.name: Driller
gta-5.desc: Steal a driller from a warehouse in La Mesa.

gta-5.name: Sidetracked
gta-5.desc: Steal a train in the Grand Senora Desert.

gta-5.name: The Big Score
gta-5.desc: Michael, Trevor, Franklin, Lester, and their accomplices steal four tons of gold bullion from the Union Depository Tower, escaping from the police and Merryweather. The heist can be performed in two ways: Subtle Approach or Obvious Approach, based on the player's choice in Planning the Big Score.
gta-5.reward: Advanced Rifle and Bullpup Rifle available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only (Bullpup Rifle))

gta-5.name: Something Sensible
gta-5.desc: Franklin must chase and kill Trevor for Steve Haines. (choosing Ending A)
gta-5.reward: The Big Score payout (Michael and Franklin only) Gusenberg Sweeper available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only)

gta-5.name: The Time's Come
gta-5.desc: Franklin must chase and kill Michael for Devin Weston. (choosing Ending B)
gta-5.reward: The Big Score payout (Trevor and Franklin only) Gusenberg Sweeper available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only) Hot Rod Blazer for Trevor

gta-5.name: The Third Way
gta-5.desc: Franklin, Michael, and Trevor must survive an onslaught from the FIB and Merryweather with Lamar and Lester's help, before splitting up to eliminate their remaining enemies: Wei Cheng, Stretch, Steve Haines, and Devin Weston. (choosing Ending C)
gta-5.reward: The Big Score payout Gusenberg Sweeper available at Ammu-Nation (PS4, XB1 & PC versions only) Hot Rod Blazer for Trevor Michael and Trevor can hang out again

gta-san-andreas.name: In the Beginning
gta-san-andreas.desc: Carl Johnson returns to Los Santos after living in Liberty City for five years. His brother Sweet Johnson informs him about his mother's death. When he reaches home, he gets captured by C.R.A.S.H. officers, who take his money and force him into their car before throwing him out within a Ballas territory. Make the way back to Grove Street to receive the first mission.

gta-san-andreas.name: Big Smoke
gta-san-andreas.desc: Carl enters his home at Grove Street, where he recalls his childhood memories and finds his deceased mother's photo. Carl reunites with his childhood friend Big Smoke, who promises to avenge his mother's death by finding the killer. Meet Big Smoke inside the Johnson House.

gta-san-andreas.name: Sweet & Kendl
gta-san-andreas.desc: Carl and Big Smoke go to a cemetery, where Carl reunites with his siblings Sweet and Kendl. Sweet blames Carl for their mother's death and explains what happened when Carl fled the city. As the gang leaves the cemetery, they are ambushed by the Ballas. They head back to Grove Street while escaping the Ballas. Arrive at the cemetery in Temple and escape from a Ballas car using a BMX.

gta-san-andreas.name: Ryder
gta-san-andreas.desc: Carl reunites with Ryder at his house on Grove Street. Ryder suggests that Carl should improve his physical appearance, so he makes him get a haircut. Afterwards, they try to deal with a pizzeria owner who keeps on spraying over Grove Street tags. Go with Ryder to get a haircut at the barber shop and eat at the pizzeria.

gta-san-andreas.name: Tagging Up Turf
gta-san-andreas.desc: Carl visits Sweet and Big Smoke at Sweet's house. Sweet questions Carl about what made him return to the hood, and gives him a spray can to let him spray over some enemy graffiti. Sweet, however, changes his mind and decides to help him. Spray over some Ballas tags.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect $200 Spray Can inside the Johnson House

gta-san-andreas.name: Cleaning the Hood
gta-san-andreas.desc: Sweet, Big Smoke and Ryder are discussing the rise in crack cocaine in the city. After a brief argument, Ryder and CJ decide to take care of the business. Take out a drug dealer in the territory of the Grove and assault a Ballas crack den.

gta-san-andreas.name: Drive-Thru
gta-san-andreas.desc: Big Smoke, Sweet, and Ryder go to eat, and CJ joins them. They head to Cluckin' Bell and get some orders. While eating, they spot the same Ballas who chased them earlier heading towards Grove Street. Visit Cluckin' Bell and stop the Ballas from getting to Grove Street.

gta-san-andreas.name: Nines and AK's
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ finds out that Grove Street Families currently have no weapons to defend themselves. Big Smoke and CJ go to pay a visit to Emmet, a member of Seville Boulevard Families, to practice some shooting. Visit Emmet for some target practice and buy clothes at a Binco shop.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Emmet's Binco, Sub Urban and ProLaps clothing

gta-san-andreas.name: Drive-By
gta-san-andreas.desc: Ryder complains about CJ's driving skills, saying that CJ always crashes cars. Sweet, however, allows CJ to drive, while he, Ryder, and Big Smoke will ride shotgun. The gang drives to a territory of the Ballas for a drive-by. Perform drive-by shootings on the Ballas.

gta-san-andreas.name: Sweet's Girl
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ gets a phone call from Sweet who says that he and his girlfriend are trapped by the Seville Boulevard Families. CJ heads to rescue them before they die. Save Sweet and his girl from an onslaught of the Seville Boulevard Families gang members.

gta-san-andreas.name: Cesar Vialpando
gta-san-andreas.desc: Sweet and Kendl argue about Kendl's relationship with Mexican gangster Cesar Vialpando, the Varrios Los Aztecas leader. Sweet tells Carl to keep an eye on her to avoid any danger. Win the Lowrider Challenge.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $50-$1,000 (based on the wager) Savanna Loco Low Co. TransFender Lowrider Challenge

gta-san-andreas.name: OG Loc
gta-san-andreas.desc: OG Loc is released from prison and CJ, Sweet, and Big Smoke go to the police station to pick him up. Loc reveals that a Mexican gangster, Freddy, raped him in jail and stole his rhymes. Loc goes to confront Freddy at his house. Pick up OG Loc from jail, chase and kill Freddy, and take OG Loc to Burger Shot.

gta-san-andreas.name: Running Dog
gta-san-andreas.desc: Smoke tells CJ that his cousin is arriving in the city from Mexico and he's going to pick her up. CJ and Smoke drive to East Los Santos where they confront two Vagos gangsters. After an argument between them, Smoke kills one member while CJ chases the other. Chase down and kill a Los Santos Vagos gang member.

gta-san-andreas.name: Wrong Side of the Tracks
gta-san-andreas.desc: Smoke informs CJ about a deal between the Vagos and San Fierro Rifa and decides to crash their meeting. After arriving at Unity Station, however, the Vagos attempt to escape by train, and Smoke and CJ give chase to stop them. Disrupt a gang meeting and follow a train.

gta-san-andreas.name: Just Business
gta-san-andreas.desc: Big Smoke has some business to take care of and goes with CJ to the Atrium in Commerce. After getting inside, they fight against the Russian Mafia. Help Big Smoke fight against the Russian Mafia in the Atrium and then escape from them using the sewer system.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Sawnoff Shotgun available in Ammu-Nation (if Doberman is completed first)

gta-san-andreas.name: Home Invasion
gta-san-andreas.desc: Ryder can't find the drugs he buried inside his lawn. He asks Carl to steal weapon crates from a war veteran living in East Beach. At 22:00, they go for the robbery. Rob a war veteran living in East Beach for weapons crates.

gta-san-andreas.name: Catalyst
gta-san-andreas.desc: After failing to find the stuff he buried, Ryder prepares his drugs. C.R.A.S.H. arrives and informs that an ammo train will be arriving shortly at East Los Santos. However, when CJ and Ryder get to the location, the Vagos and the Ballas can be seen attempting to rob the train as well. Steal crates of weapons from a train.

gta-san-andreas.name: Robbing Uncle Sam
gta-san-andreas.desc: Ryder tells CJ that the army has many weapons. They both head to an army base in Ocean Docks to steal the army weapons. Raid a National Guard base in the Ocean Docks area.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect SMG available in Ammu-Nation (if Doberman is completed first)

gta-san-andreas.name: High Stakes, Low-Rider
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ visits Cesar at his house and Cesar explains to him the rules of the street race they both are competing in. Race Cesar Vialpando and other racers in the Lowrider Race.

gta-san-andreas.name: Life's a Beach
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ visits OG Loc, who is working at the Burger Shot in Marina. Loc is planning to host a house party, but he lacks a sound system. He tells CJ to steal a sound van from a beach party. Steal a sound system Pony for OG Loc's house party.

gta-san-andreas.name: Madd Dogg's Rhymes
gta-san-andreas.desc: Although Loc has the sound system, he doesn't have rhymes to read for rapping. Loc asks CJ to steal a rhyme book owned by rapper Madd Dogg, which is found inside his mansion. Steal Madd Dogg's rhyme book.

gta-san-andreas.name: Management Issues
gta-san-andreas.desc: Now that Loc has what he wants for his party, he still isn't satisfied. Loc reveals that Madd Dogg's manager Alan Crawford is preventing Loc from getting into music, becoming Loc's huge problem. Loc wants the manager killed. Kidnap and kill Madd Dogg's manager and his girlfriend.

gta-san-andreas.name: House Party
gta-san-andreas.desc: OG Loc quits the janitor job and decides to go back to prison, but wants to have the party before. He tells CJ to prepare everything for the party. CJ visits the party, but soon gets warned about an incoming attack from the Ballas on Grove Street. CJ and Sweet defend it. Visit OG Loc's party and protect Grove Street from a Ballas attack.

gta-san-andreas.name: Burning Desire
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ reluctantly meets C.R.A.S.H at the doughnut shop. Tenpenny informs CJ about a Vagos gang member who is trying to get in their way and orders CJ to kill him. Burn down a Vagos member's house and rescue a girl.

gta-san-andreas.name: Gray Imports
gta-san-andreas.desc: Tenpenny informs CJ about a deal between the Ballas and Russians at the warehouse in Ocean Docks, and orders CJ to destroy the deal by killing the dealer. Kill a Russian arms dealer.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Silenced 9mm available in Ammu-Nation (if Doberman is completed first)

gta-san-andreas.name: Doberman
gta-san-andreas.desc: After a phone call from Sweet, CJ heads to Ammu-Nation to purchase some firearms to kill a former GSF member, who betrayed them and joined Ballas. Take over Glen Park and kill the snitch.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Access to Ammu-Nation Johnson House asset

gta-san-andreas.name: Los Sepulcros
gta-san-andreas.desc: The Ballas are holding a funeral for Little Weasel. Sweet and CJ decide to disrupt the funeral to kill the leader of the Front Yard Ballas. Raid the funeral and kill the Ballas gang leader.

gta-san-andreas.name: Reuniting the Families
gta-san-andreas.desc: Sweet decides to reunite all the Grove Street gang sets that have been split up, as the Ballas have been dealing with the drugs for too long. The gang heads to Jefferson Motel where all the sets meet, but shortly after, they are ambushed by the police. Take Sweet, Big Smoke, and Ryder to the meet to reunite the Grove Street Families and escape from the police.

gta-san-andreas.name: The Green Sabre
gta-san-andreas.desc: Following the Grove Street Families reunion, Sweet decides to put justice against the Ballas. Sweet tells CJ to meet him at the gunfight between GSF and Ballas, but CJ is forced to meet Cesar, who reveals to him Big Smoke and Ryder's true colors. Witness Smoke and Ryder's betrayal, then rush to rescue Sweet.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Access to Flint County, Whetstone, and San Fierro Countryside safehouses purchasable Angel Pine Save Point

gta-san-andreas.name: Badlands
gta-san-andreas.desc: After CJ is arrested and taken away from Los Santos, Tenpenny wants CJ to do tasks for him for Sweet's safety. In his first task, CJ has to kill an informant who has some information about Tenpenny and is hiding at Mount Chiliad guarded by the FBI. Take out an FBI witness for Tenpenny.

gta-san-andreas.name: First Date
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar calls CJ to tell him about his cousin, who can help him. CJ meets Cesar's cousin, Catalina, who gives him four targets for robberies that they will perform. Meet Cesar's cousin. NOTE: Choose a Robbery mission listed below after the cutscene (Tanker Commander is recommended, because this mission takes place in Dillimore, which is the player's location, removing the need to travel to Dillimore and then away from it).

gta-san-andreas.name: Tanker Commander
gta-san-andreas.desc: Hijack a petrol tanker in Dillimore.

gta-san-andreas.name: Body Harvest
gta-san-andreas.desc: Tenpenny introduces The Truth to CJ and tells CJ to pay Truth for the weed. Before the payment, he wants CJ to steal a combine harvester from a farm in Flint County. Steal a Combine Harvester for The Truth.

gta-san-andreas.name: King in Exile
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ meets Cesar and Kendl inside the trailer in Angel Pine. Cesar informs CJ about some suspicious drug shipments across Los Santos and San Fierro. CJ tells Cesar to lay low while he will take care of them whenever he spots them. Meet Cesar and Kendl again.

gta-san-andreas.name: First Base
gta-san-andreas.desc: Catalina is furious at CJ for abandoning the robberies. CJ apologizes to her. While initially angry at him, Catalina shows some love toward CJ. NOTE: Choose a Robbery mission listed below after the cutscene (Local Liquor Store is recommended).

gta-san-andreas.name: Local Liquor Store
gta-san-andreas.desc: Rob a liquor store in Blueberry.

gta-san-andreas.name: Gone Courting
gta-san-andreas.desc: Catalina shows her love for CJ by torturing him. NOTE: Choose a Robbery mission listed below after the cutscene (Against All Odds is recommended).

gta-san-andreas.name: Against All Odds
gta-san-andreas.desc: Rob the Inside Track betting shop in Montgomery.

gta-san-andreas.name: Made in Heaven
gta-san-andreas.desc: Catalina tells CJ that she does not love him anymore and wants to be just his partner. NOTE: Choose a Robbery mission listed below after the cutscene (Small Town Bank is recommended).

gta-san-andreas.name: Small Town Bank
gta-san-andreas.desc: Rob a bank in Palomino Creek.

gta-san-andreas.name: Wu Zi Mu
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar invites CJ for a race across Red County. Wu Zi Mu, the race organizer, arrives and says that this race will reward the winner with either cash or a pink slip. Race against Wu Zi Mu.

gta-san-andreas.name: Farewell, My Love...
gta-san-andreas.desc: Catalina confronts CJ again and introduces to him her new boyfriend, Claude. Calling CJ jealous and a coward, Catalina challenges him to a race. Race against Catalina and her new boyfriend, Claude.

gta-san-andreas.name: Are You Going to San Fierro?
gta-san-andreas.desc: After being rewarded a garage in San Fierro, CJ meets The Truth at his farm and pays him for the weed. Later, both are ambushed by the police. Truth tells CJ that they must burn the weed and leave the place. Burn down The Truth's cannabis plantation and drive to San Fierro.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect 5-star wanted level achievable Safehouses in San Fierro purchasable Doherty Garage ZIP clothing available

gta-san-andreas.name: Wear Flowers in Your Hair
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ doesn't like the reward he got for winning the race. Cesar and Kendl convince CJ by telling him that they will help him in making it into a garage. The Truth, who listened to the conversation, tells CJ that he has a few friends who can help CJ with the garage. Pick up some friends of The Truth, who can help with the garage.

gta-san-andreas.name: 555 We Tip
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ receives a phone call from Tenpenny, who informs him about a district attorney who is causing problems for C.R.A.S.H. He tells CJ to secretly plant the weeds he got from The Truth into the DA's car. Frame a district attorney that is causing Tenpenny problems, by posing as a valet and planting drugs in his car.

gta-san-andreas.name: Deconstruction
gta-san-andreas.desc: Kendl is angry with the workers at the construction site behind the garage for calling her a hooker. Cesar attempts to confront them, but CJ convinces Cesar to stay with her, telling him that he will take care of this. Get revenge on some builders for calling Kendl a hooker by destroying portable buildings and burying the foreman.

gta-san-andreas.name: Air Raid
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ visits Zero at his shop. Zero learns that his long-time rival Berkley is back. Berkley launches a full-scale attack on Zero by using RC Barons to destroy the transmitters on the rooftop. Defend Zero's transmitters from Berkley's bombers.

gta-san-andreas.name: Supply Lines...
gta-san-andreas.desc: Zero explains to CJ that Berkley humiliated him. CJ tells him to take revenge and asks what weapons Zero has, with Zero saying that he has a miniature plane, which both of them use to go after Berkley. Kill Berkley's delivery boys.

gta-san-andreas.name: New Model Army
gta-san-andreas.desc: Zero prepares for an ultimate battle against Berkley, where the loser must leave San Fierro for good. Help Zero in an RC war.

gta-san-andreas.name: Back to School
gta-san-andreas.desc: Learn some advanced driving techniques.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Driving skill increased Super GT (all bronze) Bullet (all silver) Hotknife (all gold) Wang Cars available to purchase (if Yay Ka-Boom-Boom is completed first) Banshee spawns next to the Cobra Marital Arts Gym Bullet spawns at the Burger Shot in Juniper Hollow

gta-san-andreas.name: Photo Opportunity
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar spots a Ballas car in Red County heading to San Fierro to buy drugs. After CJ meets Cesar, both head to Angel Pine where the car was seen previously. Photograph the meeting between Ryder and the members of the Loco Syndicate.

gta-san-andreas.name: Jizzy
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ meets Cesar and Woozie at his garage. Woozie explains to CJ that the people CJ took photos of are the members of the Loco Syndicate, a drug-dealing gang. CJ decides to meet one of the members of Loco Syndicate, the pimp Jizzy B., who is found at the Pleasure Domes in Battery Point. Go and meet Jizzy at his club. Help Jizzy out with his pimping duties.

gta-san-andreas.name: T-Bone Mendez
gta-san-andreas.desc: Jizzy argues with T-Bone Mendez about Jizzy's cut with the Loco Syndicate. CJ arrives and he is introduced to Mendez, but Mendez discovers that a shipment of drugs has been highjacked by bikers. Retrieve some stolen cash from the bikers.

gta-san-andreas.name: Mike Toreno
gta-san-andreas.desc: T-Bone receives a call from Mike Toreno, who says that he is in danger and needs help. The van containing the drug shipment is stolen with Toreno still inside. CJ and T-Bone go to rescue Toreno. Find and rescue Mike Toreno.

gta-san-andreas.name: Mountain Cloud Boys
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ meets Woozie at his apartment. Woozie explains that a Triad meeting that happened last time had some Triads missing. Woozie wants to meet those Triads. Escort Woozie to a Triad meeting, then escape the Da Nang Boys.

gta-san-andreas.name: Ran Fa Li
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ is introduced to Ran Fa Li, the leader of the Red Gecko Tong. Ran Fa Li explains that the Da Nang Boys are about to move to San Fierro. Woozie plans to stop them by allowing CJ to steal a car with a package inside from the airport. Steal a car from the airport and take it to a lockup, escaping the Da Nang Boys.

gta-san-andreas.name: Lure
gta-san-andreas.desc: The Da Nang Boys are after Ran Fa Li, preventing him from going back home. CJ thinks of a plan to lure the Da Nang Boys by acting as a decoy so that Ran Fa Li and his assistants can leave Chinatown safely. Act as a decoy for Ran Fa Li, and lead the Da Nang Boys on a chase through the countryside.

gta-san-andreas.name: Amphibious Assault
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie plans to plant a bug on a ship owned by the Da Nang boys. He asks CJ to do it, but CJ initially refuses as he is scared of swimming. Woozie admits that he cannot do it as he is blind, leading CJ to finally agree. Plant a bug on a ship of the Da Nang Boys.

gta-san-andreas.name: The Da Nang Thang
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie is informed by his Triad that the Da Nang Boys have arrived with their leader, The Snakehead, on a freighter ship. They brought along some refugees locked inside a container as well. CJ and the Triad launch an attack on the ship. Sneak on board, release some slaves from the ship, and kill The Snakehead.

gta-san-andreas.name: Outrider
gta-san-andreas.desc: After getting orders from Jizzy, CJ gets in a car in Easter Basin, only to be ambushed by T-Bone from behind, as he suspects CJ to be working for someone else. CJ convinces T-Bone that he is only working for money. Toreno arrives and orders CJ to look after the shipment delivery. Transport drugs past roadblocks.

gta-san-andreas.name: Snail Trail
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ meets Tenpenny and Pulaski in his office. Tenpenny informs CJ about a journalist who is trying to investigate Pulaski and orders CJ to kill both him and a reporter meeting him. Take out the reporter and the journalist.

gta-san-andreas.name: Ice Cold Killa
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie has left a message about the meeting between the Ballas and the Loco Syndicate, but CJ has to find out where the meeting will take place. The only way to find out is through Jizzy's phone, so CJ decides to kill Jizzy to take his phone and discover the meeting's location. Break into the Pleasure Domes and kill Jizzy B.

gta-san-andreas.name: Pier 69
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ finds out that the meeting will take place at Pier 69. CJ and Cesar plan to stop the meeting with help from Woozie's Triads before the deal is successful. Raid a deal between the Ballas and the Loco Syndicate to kill T-Bone Mendez and Ryder.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $15,000 Respect Sniper Rifle available in Ammu-Nation

gta-san-andreas.name: Toreno's Last Flight
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie informs CJ that Mike Toreno's helicopter is at the police headquarters about to take off. CJ invades the place to stop the helicopter. Shoot down Mike Toreno's helicopter.

gta-san-andreas.name: Yay Ka-Boom-Boom
gta-san-andreas.desc: The Loco Syndicate has almost come to an end. Woozie says that the only thing left is to destroy the crack factory in Doherty to end the Syndicate for good. Blow up the Loco Syndicate's drug factory.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $25,000 Respect Access to Tierra Robada, Bone County, and Las Venturas Desert safehouses buyable Wang Cars showroom buyable (if Back to School is completed first) M4 available in Ammu-Nation Mike Toreno's Ranch

gta-san-andreas.name: Zeroing In
gta-san-andreas.desc: Zero reveals he has prepared a tracking automobile that tracks the cellphone signals made by the driver. CJ uses it to steal a vehicle. Steal a car with the help of a tracking system.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $5,000 Respect Uranus in Wang Cars showroom Wheel Arch Angels available

gta-san-andreas.name: Test Drive
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar informs CJ that he has located two more cars on a customer's wishlist. CJ and Cesar drive to an automobile showroom to steal the cars. Steal and test some racing cars with Cesar.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $5,000 Respect Elegy and Sultan in Wang Cars showroom

gta-san-andreas.name: Customs Fast Track
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar reveals that there is another car that is loaded onto a container in Easter Basin. Cesar and CJ head to the docks to find it. Steal a car from a container at the docks and beat the security guards.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Up to $10,000 Respect Savanna in Wang Cars showroom

gta-san-andreas.name: Puncture Wounds
gta-san-andreas.desc: Cesar is angry because he failed to steal a car, saying that the driver is too fast. CJ plans to use stingers to stop and puncture the car. Use stingers to steal a Stratum.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $5,000 Respect Stratum in Wang Cars showroom Wang Cars showroom as an asset

gta-san-andreas.name: Monster
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ walks into a mysterious voice, who seems to know about CJ's family. The voice tells CJ that he needs to impress him by driving a Monster within the time limit. Complete a time trial in a Monster Truck.

gta-san-andreas.name: Highjack
gta-san-andreas.desc: Mike Toreno, the man behind the mysterious voice, surprises CJ and reveals his real identity to him. Toreno wants CJ to do some tasks for him, the first one being commandeering a tanker truck. Hijack a tanker and drive it back to Doherty with Cesar.

gta-san-andreas.name: Interdiction
gta-san-andreas.desc: Mike Toreno explains to CJ his brother's status and Frank Tenpenny's crimes. He states that a cargo helicopter is delivering contraband and wants CJ to collect it by defending the helicopter. Escort and protect Toreno's helicopter, then take the contraband dropped by it.

gta-san-andreas.name: Verdant Meadows
gta-san-andreas.desc: After CJ successfully does Mike Toreno's favor, Toreno wants him to purchase an abandoned airstrip in Bone County. Purchase the Verdant Meadows airstrip in Bone County.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Verdant Meadows Airfield available to purchase

gta-san-andreas.name: Learning to Fly
gta-san-andreas.desc: Toreno tells CJ to learn to fly by taking flying lessons at the airstrip. CJ initially refuses but accepts after Toreno tells him that this is a step toward his brother's release from prison. Complete the ten Pilot School courses.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Pilot's license (if the player has a low flying skill stat before finishing this mission) Increased Flying Skill Rustler spawns at Verdant Meadows Police Maverick spawns on the roof of the Los Santos Police Headquarters Raindance spawns on Santa Maria Beach Stuntplane spawns at Verdant Meadows (if the player has completed all tests with silver medals) Hunter spawns at the Easter Basin Naval Station (always) and at Verdant Meadows (if the player has completed all tests with gold medals) Las Venturas safehouses purchasable The Four Dragons Casino 6-star wanted level achievable All aircraft in Easter Bay Airport apart from the Maverick are unlocked Victim

gta-san-andreas.name: N.O.E.
gta-san-andreas.desc: Toreno explains that his agents are in trouble and need some equipment. Toreno wants CJ to deliver a package of equipment using a plane before nightfall. Fly under the radar to Angel Pine and back within the time limit.

gta-san-andreas.name: Stowaway
gta-san-andreas.desc: A cargo plane arrives at the airstrip with some government agents. Toreno reveals that those people are from a rival agency. Toreno wants CJ to kill all the agents and blow up the plane. Destroy a government plane.

gta-san-andreas.name: Black Project
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ meets The Truth at the airstrip. Truth questions CJ about working for the government and then explains to him about a powerful military base where the Black Project is being developed. The Truth wants CJ to steal the Black Project. Break into Area 69 and steal the Black Project.

gta-san-andreas.name: Green Goo
gta-san-andreas.desc: The Truth flies the Jetpack that CJ has stolen, but falls off due to being unable to control it. Truth tells CJ to steal unknown stuff from a train using the Jetpack. Using the Jetpack, steal the Green Goo from a train.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $20,000 Jetpack at Verdant Meadows Verdant Meadows Airfield as an asset

gta-san-andreas.name: Fender Ketchup
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie invites CJ to his new business, The Four Dragons Casino, in Las Venturas. CJ meets him at the casino. Woozie explains that the Mafia are causing trouble for his business. Woozie offers CJ a share in the casino, in exchange for CJ's help. A mafia thug was caught and Woozie wants to get rid of him, whereas CJ has another plan in mind. Scare Johnny Sindacco by driving around with him on the car's windscreen.

gta-san-andreas.name: Explosive Situation
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ finds out that the Sindacco Family is the main problem for Woozie's casino. Knowing this, Woozie asks CJ to get dynamite from the Hunter Quarry. Steal the dynamite from the Hunter Quarry.

gta-san-andreas.name: You've Had Your Chips
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie receives two casino chips and finds out that one of them is fake. An enraged Woozie deduces that the Sindacco Family is behind this, and wants to blow up the chip factory where these chips are made. CJ tells Woozie that he got this. Destroy the Sindacco's fake casino chip-making machines.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $10,000 Respect Combat Shotgun available in Ammu-Nation

gta-san-andreas.name: Don Peyote
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ receives a call from The Truth, who says that he went on a peyote safari with a band and something unknowingly happened that led to him being separated from them. Truth tells that they're in Arco del Oeste and asks CJ to go there and check whether the pair are alive or not. Rescue Maccer and Kent Paul from the desert and bring them to Caligula's Palace, escaping the snake farmers.

gta-san-andreas.name: Architectural Espionage
gta-san-andreas.desc: Woozie plans a heist at Caligula's Casino. To prepare for that, the first step they need to take is to get the blueprints for the casino. CJ heads to the City Planning Department where the blueprints are located to take a photo of them. Steal the blueprints of Caligula's Casino.

gta-san-andreas.name: Key to Her Heart
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ and Woozie got the blueprints. The next step is to get a keycard for the casino that allows access to restricted areas in the casino. The casino's croupier has the keycard, and CJ needs to gain her trust to get the keycard. Gain the affection of Millie Perkins to gain a keycard for the casino.
gta-san-andreas.reward: Respect Millie as a girlfriend Gimp Suit

gta-san-andreas.name: Dam and Blast
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ gained the trust of Millie Perkins and the keycard is yet to be received anytime. The next step is to establish a means of temporarily cutting the power supply to Las Venturas, so that the power could be disabled during the heist. CJ heads to the Sherman Dam to plant explosives on the generators. Plant explosive charges on the generators at the Sherman Dam.

gta-san-andreas.name: Cop Wheels
gta-san-andreas.desc: After planting explosive charges on the generators, CJ's next step is to steal four police bikes that need to be used as outriders for an armored vehicle where the cash is hauled off. CJ heads to steal the bikes within a limited time. Steal four police bikes.

gta-san-andreas.name: Up, Up and Away!
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ has stolen the police bikes. His final step is to steal an armored truck that must be used as a getaway vehicle to haul off cash. Instead of gaining suspicion by simple carjacking, the team plans to steal a sky crane to lift the truck. CJ heads to the K.A.C.C. military depot where the sky crane is located. Steal an armored truck using a Leviathan obtained from the K.A.C.C. Military Fuels.

gta-san-andreas.name: Intensive Care
gta-san-andreas.desc: Ken Rosenberg is distressed, stating that he is under pressure from the three mafia families. To make things worse, the Forellis learn that Johnny Sindacco, whom CJ scared previously, is in a coma and they plan to kidnap him. CJ decides to rescue Johnny to keep Rosenberg safe. Rescue Johnny Sindacco from the ambulance hijacked by the Forelli Crime Family.

gta-san-andreas.name: The Meat Business
gta-san-andreas.desc: Ken Rosenberg is out of distress and decides to visit the Sindacco Family. CJ and Rosie head to the Sindaccos' abattoir to visit Johnny Sindacco, who is recovering from a coma. However, Johnny dies of a heart attack after seeing CJ, the one who put him in this state. The Sindaccos realize the truth and launch an attack on CJ and Rosie. Escape from the meat factory.

gta-san-andreas.name: Fish in a Barrel
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ and Ran Fa Li meet Woozie at the casino. Woozie makes both of them sign a document to become his partners in the casino. Take co-ownership of the Four Dragons Casino.

gta-san-andreas.name: Madd Dogg
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ finds out that rapper Madd Dogg is attempting suicide because of losing everything as his rhyme book was stolen and his manager was killed. CJ advises him not to do so, but Madd Dogg ignores him and proceeds to jump. Rescue Madd Dogg from a suicide attempt.

gta-san-andreas.name: Freefall
gta-san-andreas.desc: Salvatore Leone, the leader of the Leone Family, is at Caligula's Casino and meets CJ. He informs CJ that a plane containing Forelli hitmen is arriving at Las Venturas to kill him, and orders CJ to stop them from arriving. Intercept, board, empty, and land a plane full of Forellis.

gta-san-andreas.name: Misappropriation
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ visits C.R.A.S.H. at a house in Prickle Pine. Tenpenny is infuriated about his career coming to an end. He informs CJ about an FBI agent carrying a dossier containing information about their corruption and orders CJ to kill him and get the dossier. Kill some federal agents in Bone County and steal a dossier.

gta-san-andreas.name: High Noon
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ gives C.R.A.S.H. the dossier he has stolen and asks if he's done with them, but Tenpenny is still infuriated when he attacks Jimmy Hernandez and berates him for selling them out. He then orders CJ to dig the grave for Hernandez and himself and leaves Pulaski to look after CJ while he's digging. CJ tries to convince Pulaski, but fails as Pulaski kills Hernandez and attempts to escape. Chase and kill Eddie Pulaski.

gta-san-andreas.name: Saint Mark's Bistro
gta-san-andreas.desc: Salvatore congratulates CJ for taking out the Forellis and decides to send CJ to Marco's Bistro to take out Marco Forelli. He also allows CJ to select Paul, Maccer, and Rosenberg as his backups. However, CJ tells the three of them to leave Las Venturas, while he does the task. Fly to Liberty City and kill Marco Forelli and his men.

gta-san-andreas.name: Breaking the Bank at Caligula's
gta-san-andreas.desc: Now that all the preparations are done, it's time for the ultimate heist. CJ and his crew go to rob Caligula's Casino. Rob the Caligula's Casino and escape back to the airstrip.

gta-san-andreas.name: A Home in the Hills
gta-san-andreas.desc: Madd Dogg has recovered and decides to go back to his mansion in Los Santos, but the mansion is seized by the Los Santos Vagos and their leader Big Poppa. CJ decides to permanently return to Los Santos to take back the mansion and use it as his new base of operations. Retake Madd Dogg's Crib and kill Big Poppa.

gta-san-andreas.name: Vertical Bird
gta-san-andreas.desc: Toreno returns to CJ and requests for another task to be performed by him in exchange for his brother's release from prison. Steal a Hydra from an aircraft carrier and use it to destroy some spy ships while defending against enemy jets.
gta-san-andreas.reward: $50,000 Respect Hydra at Verdant Meadows Weapons at Mike Toreno's Ranch

gta-san-andreas.name: Home Coming
gta-san-andreas.desc: Toreno asks for one final job to be done by CJ, but CJ gets annoyed and threatens to kill him. CJ, however, receives a call from his brother Sweet saying that he has been released from prison. CJ asks Toreno what the job is, with Toreno saying none other than picking up his brother. Pick up Sweet from the police station, take out some drug dealers, and reclaim Ganton from the Ballas.

gta-san-andreas.name: Cut Throat Business
gta-san-andreas.desc: Madd Dogg finds out that the rival rapper OG Loc is at a video shoot and that the rhymes by Loc are actually from his book that CJ stole for Loc before. CJ and Madd Dogg decide to go to the shoot to interrupt Loc. Chase OG Loc to reclaim Madd Dogg's rhyme book.

gta-san-andreas.name: Beat Down on B Dup
gta-san-andreas.desc: Sweet is about to smoke crack from one of B Dup's crack whores and is stopped by CJ. CJ and Sweet go to confront B Dup at his house, only to find out that B Dup has shifted to Glen Park. They then head to Glen Park. Start a gang war to reclaim Glen Park, and then confront B Dup.

gta-san-andreas.name: Grove 4 Life
gta-san-andreas.desc: Sweet is happy to see the Grove Street Families back. He then comes into an argument with CJ about CJ abandoning Grove Street. CJ admits to it and then both of them set out to put Grove Street back on the map. Claim two areas of Idlewood from the Ballas.

gta-san-andreas.name: Riot
gta-san-andreas.desc: CJ and his group find out in the news that Tenpenny is finally arrested due to his corruption, but then, due to lack of evidence, he is released. This leads to riots all over the city. Drive to Grove Street from the mansion and witness the riot.
